messages:
Maya (eng-sre): quick follow-up from the Sapphire postmortem. Root cause summary: intermittent VPC peering flaps combined with on-prem NAT asymmetry caused session pinning to break and triggered isolation for Dedicated pools. Need owners, short mitigations, and tests.

Owen (eng-runtime): I can own the runtime fallback and sticky-session fix. Plan: feature flag + small KV fallback so peers don't rely on source IP. ETA 2026-04-11.

Priya (eng-platform): I'll build a config validator for asymmetrical NAT and a CI job to block bad Dedicated configs. ETA 2026-04-17.

Ruth (customer-success): Customer requested an immediate mitigation window to reduce idle timeouts and deprioritize flaky peer routes. They've agreed to a 30-min maintenance slot.

infra-bot: maintenance scheduled by Ruth: "Sapphire peering mitigation" 2026-04-08T02:00:00Z - 2026-04-08T02:30:00Z (ref: #maint-180300).

Maya (eng-sre): Action items (please link tickets/PRs back here):
- S1: Peer-flap detectors + alerting (owner: Maya) due: 2026-04-10 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3801
- S2: Runtime KV fallback flag (owner: Owen) due: 2026-04-11 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3802
- S3: On-prem config validator + CI (owner: Priya) due: 2026-04-17 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3803
- S4: Interim maint + comms (owner: Ruth) due: 2026-04-07 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3804

Owen (eng-runtime): pushed a failing unit test simulating NAT drift. log snippet: `[2026-03-31T08:05:12Z] conn 0x1ab: src=10.3.4.5 translated=52.23.8.9 mismatch -> isolation event`. Will link RD-3802 once PR is green.

Priya (eng-platform): prototype validator uploaded to RD-3803. quick check: `redwood-validate --check-nat-symmetry customer-config.yaml`. Marking RD-3803 as blocker for Dedicated onboarding.

Maya (eng-sre): added rollback play and alerting rule to RD-3801: `if peer_down > 120s then page SRE`. Also scheduling weekly follow-ups (Tuesdays 15:00 UTC) until tickets close.

Ruth (customer-success): I'll send pre-window comms with rollback steps and contact list. Customer wants a post-maintenance summary within 2 hours.

Owen (eng-runtime): final note: prioritize S4 during maintenance, then S2, then S3. Ping me if anyone needs pairing on the runtime change. :white_check_mark:
